interface.title: vMPT — visual MSA Planning Tool
interface.field: Astronomy / JWST NIRSpec multi-object spectroscopy observation planning
interface.stage_of_work: Observation design (proposal / APT planning stage, before data are taken)
interface.what_it_is_for: Place the JWST NIRSpec micro-shutter array over a target-field image, search pointing and roll for the placement that catches the most catalog targets, hand-pick shutters while watching for spectra that would overlap, then save the session or export an APT-importable plan and catalog.

data.note: The one-click 'Load Abell 370 example' filled in and loaded only the FITS image (a370_f182m_f200w_f210m.fits, 2200×2500). According to the reviewer, the example_a370/ folder does hold the bundled target catalog (A370_zspec_charge_hst.fits) and the GTO-1208 APT plans ('a370 plan 1', 'a370 plan 2', 'a370 plan 3 (Obs 46).json'), but this run never loaded them; the agent guessed wrong file names (example_a370/a370_catalog.csv and example_a370/catalog.csv both gave 'not a file'). The only catalog used was synthetic: the agent hand-picked 4 slitlets, exported an APT bundle, and loaded its vMPT_targets_APT_catalog.cat (4 vMPT_synth targets, weight 5, no priority column) back in. Optimizer results in this tree therefore show only that the mechanics work, not how they behave on real targets. All files are server-side paths under /work/app/exports. Nothing went to the browser's downloads.

tree.general: Design a multi-object spectroscopy observation that catches as many targets as possible without overlapping spectra, and hand it to the observatory's planning software
tree.specific: Configure NIRSpec MSA pointing, roll and shutters on an Abell 370 image and export an APT/eMPT bundle

features.name: Instrument footprint overlay with pointing and rotation controls
features.general: Overlay a rotatable instrument footprint on a sky image. Set its centre by typing coordinates or shift-clicking, set its angle in either of two linked angle conventions, and watch the footprint and the known-bad elements redraw.
features.specific: NIRSpec MSA quadrants and stuck-open conflict rows drawn on the FITS image. Pointing RA/Dec fields, a V3 PA slider and exact field linked to NIRSpec APA (APA = V3PA + 138.57°), and Shift+click to recentre on the lime cross.
steps: Type a V3 PA (or APA) or drag the slider
Shift+click the image to move the pointing centre
Read the new RA/Dec/PA in the stats bar
serves_tasks: Rotate the instrument footprint to a chosen angle
Re-centre the footprint on a spot in the image

features.name: Click-to-open apertures with live collision shading
features.general: Click objects on an image to open fixed-length apertures that snap to the nearest usable element. Rows blocked by fixed defects, rows blocked by your own picks, and actual overlaps between apertures are tinted live in distinct colours, and a hover tooltip shows each aperture's wavelength coverage. Undo steps back.
features.specific: Pick mode: a click opens an N-shutter slitlet (N=1/2/3/5, with snap to nearest operable). Pink = row masked by a stuck-open shutter, orange = row masked by a user pick, purple = conflict between two slitlets. Hovering shows Q/s/d, λ range and NRS gap. Undo last keeps 50 steps of history (Clear open was not tried). In replay, canvas clicks were often ignored and one opened a shutter at an earlier click position instead of where the click landed.
steps: Click a source to open a slitlet
Hover to read λ range and detector gap
Click inside a coloured row to see the conflict
serves_tasks: Open apertures on chosen objects and see which rows are now blocked or overlapping
Change aperture length and pick again
Make a conflicting pick and take it back

features.name: Placement optimizer with ranked, applicable solutions
features.general: Search a box in position and angle for the placement that maximises a score (count, summed weight, or strict priority tiers). Optionally keep protected targets free of contamination. Show the top solutions as a table, and apply any row back to the main view.
features.specific: MSA pointing optimizer: Method Democracy/Meritocracy/Hierarchy, ΔRA/ΔDec/ΔPA search box, Refine top N, source centering constraint. Collision protection by priority ≤ or weight ≥ a threshold. Advanced settings cover grid sizes, DE iterations, objective, source σ, DVA θ, priority cutoff and max configs per source. The results table has Score/ΔRA/ΔDec/ΔPA and an Apply #N button that replaces the open shutters. Only Democracy was run, and only on a 4-target synthetic catalog; collision protection was only seen refusing a catalog without priorities.
steps: Open optimizer and choose method and search box
Optionally enable collision protection with a threshold
serves_tasks: Run an automatic search over position and angle that maximises captured targets, then apply a ranked solution
Protect chosen high-priority targets from contamination during the search

features.name: Selected-targets table with column chooser
features.general: List the items currently selected across configurations in a table. Choose and reorder columns by dragging chips, and save the list to CSV.
features.specific: View MPT catalog… lists the sources placed in open shutters per config (Source ID, RA, Dec, Pri, Weight, Mag, z, λ_blue, λ_red, Gap, Q, s, d, Label), with draggable/removable column chips and Save as CSV.
steps: Open apertures by hand or with the optimizer
serves_tasks: Review the table of selected targets

features.name: Session save and plan-bundle export
features.general: Save the working state to a file, and write the current configuration as a bundle of files a downstream planning tool can import.
features.specific: MPT tab: Save session (vMPT session JSON, prefilled /work/app/exports/MPT_plan.json). Export to APT writes an eMPT bundle directory with vMPT_targets_MPT_plan.json, an APT-importable .cat, README, workspace and 3 eMPT files, and reports target and open-shutter counts.
steps: Open Save session… and save to a path
Export eMPT bundle to a directory
Read the status listing the written files and counts
serves_tasks: Save the working session for a collaborator
Export the configuration for the observatory planning tool

features.name: Plan import with plan picker
features.general: Read a saved observing plan back in, choose one of the plans it contains, and restore its apertures and orientation.
features.specific: Import…: source types APT/MPT plan (JSON), shutter mask CSV, APT program (.aptx or ID) and vMPT session. For a plan JSON, a picker lists the plans (e.g. 'c1 (8 open)'); Load plan from JSON restores open shutters, APA and V3 PA. Only the plan-JSON route was carried through.
steps: Pick a plan from the list
Load plan and see shutters/PA restored
serves_tasks: Re-load an exported plan to continue or review it

features.name: Image stretch dialog with histogram and colormap
features.general: Adjust how an image is displayed (tone curve, scaling method, clipping percentile, colour map, invert) against a live pixel histogram, keep the current pan and zoom, and reset to defaults.
features.specific: Image display: FITS tone curve Linear/Sqrt/Asinh/Log, scaling Percentile/Manual vmin–vmax/ZScale, percentile 99.5–Min–Max, colormap picker (Gray, Viridis, Inferno…), invert, NaN as white, pixel histogram with draggable vmin/vmax markers, canvas size. Reset display to defaults lives in the Settings tab.
serves_tasks: Change the image stretch and colour map

features.name: Layer visibility and appearance panel
features.general: Toggle each overlay layer on or off and tune its transparency and outline width.
features.specific: Layers dialog: show MSA outline, operable shutters, catalog targets, DS9 regions and contours, plus per-layer Alpha and Stroke sliders.
steps: Choose a layer and drag Alpha/Stroke
serves_tasks: Show or hide overlay layers and tune their transparency
